Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.customgame

Record Class CustomGameInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.customgame.CustomGameInfo
Record Components:
id - the custom game's stable ID
hostId - the host
hostName - the host's name when they published it
gameTypeName - the game type it is played as
sourceArenaName - the arena its worlds are built from
addonSource - whether an addon's arena source supplied that arena
scenarioIds - the scenarios it runs, in order
state - where it is in its life
scheduledAt - when its match starts, in epoch milliseconds
publishedAt - when it was published, in epoch milliseconds
passwordProtected - whether players need a password to join
joinable - whether players may join right now
playerCount - how many players are in its lobby or match now
remainingCapacity - how many more players fit
runtimeId - the runtime ID of its lobby or match while one exists, or null
public record CustomGameInfo(@NotNull UUID id, @NotNull UUID hostId, @NotNull String hostName, @NotNull String gameTypeName, @NotNull String sourceArenaName, boolean addonSource, @NotNull List<String> scenarioIds, @NotNull CustomGameState state, long scheduledAt, long publishedAt, boolean passwordProtected, boolean joinable, int playerCount, int remainingCapacity, @Nullable String runtimeId) extends Record
A player-hosted custom game, read at one moment. A snapshot: it does not follow later changes.

Everything the host decided is frozen at publication. A password-protected game reports only that it is protected; the password itself is never exposed.

Since:
1.8.0
